61adc4ebe221261273d8a1b9e4e044cae041187d.text: Welcome. Sit in a stable chair with both feet supported, and keep a carer nearby if you need help with balance. We will practise one slow knee movement at a time.

d331cb2ba80b0ce68275d8efa52ad2842d4e673b.text: Move the phone back until I can see your hips, knees and feet. Sit still with both feet supported.

080529686aa6cc619f8f46821388270fe6c32017.text: Slowly straighten your affected knee within a comfortable range. Keep your thigh supported and breathe normally. Hold it there.

6227640ed759ace8de368fda6d8301cbac43f22f.text: Now gently bend the knee and lower your foot back to the floor, slowly.

037f6d25aa1c0b50d9a132832e39cf9d03dc6ecd.text: Your hip lifted off the chair. Keep both hips settled while the lower leg moves.

cf62905920aa752c4ab5976338b53fecc4df2430.text: You leaned back to lift the foot. Stay tall on the next one.

a0b89cdb5c9eda9e5f78bac0c61f24e7c508c62c.text: Almost straight. On the next try, reach a little further if it feels comfortable.

e75fb062a1308d28fd0b3e596c2ecafdbef71937.text: Well done. Keep the movement slow and let the leg do as much as it safely can.

30f6167bf9198e86885ad9feb3e39d45561d7c86.text: Sit securely with your affected foot flat and your heel supported on the floor. We will practise lifting the front of your foot without lifting the heel.

1da02d75a478a28fd620620438331232ae10350e.text: Move the phone back until I can see your hips, knees and feet. Keep the heel down and hold still.

e892d3f34a62201b12c76018e6f1771818373c4d.text: Keeping the heel down, gently lift your toes and the front of your foot. Hold for a comfortable moment.

a353d1da6038f2aa327b46be2102c95f234513ff.text: Lift your toes and forefoot, and hold.

347ade1abd02ff1badccb1dcb8d8d531bb088329.text: Lower the front of your foot slowly until it rests on the floor.

af0cb8630821e93a8270cfa5757bf0e71c3d4972.text: Your knee lifted with the foot. Keep the knee quiet while the ankle moves.

7deae918678b2e22595e07158c32cd4faf5eab59.text: Nearly there. Keep the heel planted and aim for a slightly higher toe lift.

fc07af53983d227864f182409c2d585e52ee5a3a.text: Great effort. Keep the heel planted and the lift smooth.

f2b8f38802c0222295d6e770f5badd92845616c4.text: Straighten your elbow a little more as you reach toward the circle.

15dce7bf07d6affdc86cc8d1df2058ec2bfc36c2.text: Lift your arm a little more from your shoulder, keeping your chest upright.

83711d7ccf88f526552bf7af0c83828dbbdc2530.text: The next target will be a little closer.

a8e8f995a3c651af390fe3e1fd0d2fac5f17b51d.text: Keep your face and both shoulders in view so I can check your posture.

d948a61c9358b22291c13df87b09412fb4b04155.text: You reached the movement targets with a smooth movement.

5513a60365dd82f9b7d67fe6bedc4fae3e33b9bb.text: Keep your face and both shoulders in view so I can check your posture on the next repetition.

765926bcf3ee128eda888f1280cdfcb09768c96f.text: You reached the movement targets. Keep the same smooth movement on your next repetition.

224adf19ee0ae0b25600be9b2aece67ce05087b8.text: I noticed your back leaned forward. Try keeping your spine tall and let your arm do the work.

b901213ee3b5bda86073b1548d65046b29ce6616.text: Your shoulder lifted up toward your ear. Try keeping your shoulder relaxed and dropped down.
